verse.verse_2: I worship not, that which ye worship.
verse.verse_3: Nor are ye the worshippers of that which I worship.
verse.verse_4: And I shall not be a worshipper of that which ye have worshipped,
verse.verse_5: Nor will ye be worshippers of that which I worship,
verse.verse_6: Yours shall be your requital, and mine shall be my requital.
